Delhi Notifies New Electric Vehicle Policy Aiming for Greener Transport

The Delhi government has notified its new Electric Vehicle (EV) Policy, targeting structural transport reforms and a mandatory electrification plan. The policy aims to establish a clean, modern, and green transport system by 2030. This initiative is expected to drive the adoption of electric vehicles within the city.
